title: Enrollment Standard for the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs
content:
An enrollment in the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs is recorded only when the conditions of its program type are met; the details of the enrollment are copied exactly from the card, award letter or hub confirmation the patient reads out.

## 1. Conditions

**1.1 Commercial coverage.** A program that requires commercial coverage is enrolled only when the patient has a coverage record in active status whose class is not a government program. The evidence is the system's coverage record, checked before enrolling; the enrollment is linked to that same coverage record.

**1.2 Government coverage.** Where the program is not usable with a government plan, it is not enrolled while the patient's primary coverage is a government class.

**1.3 Prescription on file.** Where enrollment needs a Kestrel prescription, the program is enrolled only for a drug with a Kestrel prescription in received or active status. The evidence is the system's prescription record, checked before enrolling, and the enrollment is tied to that same prescription.

**1.4 Prior authorization.** A program that applies only while prior authorization is pending or denied is enrolled only while the patient's most recent prior authorization for the drug is waiting for a decision or was denied.

**1.5 Age.** The enrolling patient must be at least the program type's minimum age, in whole years, on the day of enrollment.

**1.6 Income attestation.** Where income attestation is required, the program is enrolled only after the patient attests that household income is no more than the program's income limit, stated as a percent of the federal poverty level; the attestation is recorded on the enrollment as given. This is the patient's own statement: Kestrel records the attestation and never checks income documents.

**1.7 Household.** A family membership covers no more than the program type's maximum number of covered people, all at the enrolling patient's address where the program requires a shared address.

**1.8 Who enrolls.** Kestrel enrolls patients itself only in program types enrolled by Kestrel; for the other program types it records the enrollment the patient already obtained from the manufacturer hub or the foundation.

## 2. Evidence at a glance

| Condition | What decides it | Tied to |
|---|---|---|
| Commercial coverage active | Coverage record on file, status active, class not government | The coverage the program is linked to |
| Prescription on file | Kestrel prescription, status received or active | The prescription the program is tied to |
| Income attested | The patient's own attestation | The enrolling patient |

## 3. Hypothetical cases

- A patient's only coverage record is active but of a government class. A program requiring commercial coverage is not enrolled.
- A patient's prescription for the drug shows received status. The prescription condition is met.
- A patient turns 18 the day after the enrollment is requested, for a program with an 18-year minimum. On the day of enrollment the patient is 17, so the program is not enrolled that day.
